pull.title: Qualify async CARv2 storage and execute all async regression suites
pull.body:
Bring the async CARv2 adapter history from draft #1 onto a qualified source branch. Provider source is byte-identical to reviewed head 5280fce589feb28a84d51e58d0af9f068858649e, including both fixes retaining shared content-addressed packs after CAS loss or ambiguous catalog failures. No live fleet, endpoint, token or deployment is activated.

Fix the runner that required async-test without running it. Add a real CID verifier and regressions proving a winner's pack survives a stale-read CAS loser and ambiguous manifest/CAS errors. A compiled negative control using actual older rollback implementation d77c943 destroys winner data and exits 1. Normalize Node built-in test imports for the real compiler.

The self-contained host gate stages byte-identical extension views, runs every JVM/compiled-Node namespace, propagates async failure and lints actual source views. Original production test/text/spec pins stay intact; a distinct test-only coordinate selects the dependency-free shared bridge from Kotoba main f0ecb24b722664b825ab89992e9cc98c37ecaaf0. Synchronize nbb runtime dependencies and use the same gate in the existing disabled CI definition. No Actions enablement or credentials changed.

Validation: JVM12 tests/53 assertions; compiled ClojureScript17 tests/70 assertions; lint0errors/0warnings; shared bridge planted async failure+exception exits1; old-rollback control fails; git diff --check. Native/Wasm, durable production shards, deployed multi-writer catalog and signed-order admission remain unqualified. Amu stays separate. This source/compatibility qualification supports [JUN-267](https://linear.app/kotobalabs/issue/JUN-267)'s monorepo placement goal.

pull.title: Add async CARv2 Kura storage adapter
pull.body:
## Summary

- Add an async CARv2-backed `kotobase.storage` adapter over Kura shard stores, with bounded packs and a durable linearizable CAS catalog.
- Read frame ranges on the normal path. Recover a missing range from local data and parity slices, then use digest-checked full-pack reconstruction if local recovery fails.
- Keep placement policy and arbitrary CID verification injected.
- Retain content-addressed packs after failed or losing CAS writes; catalog-aware garbage collection owns safe orphan removal.

## Current-head validation

- Exact head: `5280fce589feb28a84d51e58d0af9f068858649e`.
- `git diff --check` passed for the CAS-loser cleanup fix.
- No test or lint command was run on this head. The previously reported 15 tests/59 assertions and lint result came from an earlier head.
- GitHub currently lists no Actions checks for this head.
- The implementation and developer commands still use `.cljk`, KBB/CLJS, and `clojure -M:lint`; they have not been migrated to the Amu/Kotoba build path. Keep this PR in draft until that path and exact-head validation are in place.

## Qualification limits

The restart fixture is test-only: its catalog CAS is single-process and its fake Kura shard stores remain in memory. It verifies catalog serialization and adapter lookup across a backend reopen, but does not qualify durable Kura shard storage, multi-writer CAS, or a deployed catalog. This PR does not activate the adapter on the AIUEOS/Tailscale cluster. Signed-order admission, independent failure-domain qualification, live Kubo/S3 interoperability and performance comparison, and YATA token funding/settlement remain unqualified. It changes no production data or token settings.

reviews.body: Static review of the exact head found a concurrency cleanup hazard. I did not run the Clojure/ClojureScript test commands; this draft also has no Actions result on the current head, so it is not merge-qualified.

Static review of exact head `8b64c0c222c46f09aadc3184278433adc3596d97` found two blockers. The inline comment describes a remaining deletion race: with two identical writers, both use the same content-addressed `carv2-<pack-cid>`; after writer A publishes refs, writer B can receive all `published? false` CAS results and delete the shared object, leaving A's successful refs pointed at missing shards. The earlier change handles rejected/ambiguous CAS but not the fully completed losing-writer case. Keep the object for catalog-aware garbage collection unless deletion can prove it is unreferenced under a safe coordination protocol. Also, this PR still implements the adapter in `.cljk`, tests it through KBB/CLJS, and documents `clojure -M:lint`. The project direction is Amu/Kotoba ownership of application logic and build outputs, with JavaScript limited to host APIs. Migrate the adapter and validation/build path before merge. I did not run Clojure/CLJS commands; the current head has no Actions result.

Static review of current head `5280fce589feb28a84d51e58d0af9f068858649e`: the prior failed-CAS cleanup race is corrected; `persist-pack-manifest>` no longer deletes a shared content-addressed pack after CAS contention. Two merge blockers remain. First, the adapter and test path still depend on `.cljk`/ClojureScript, and the README documents `clojure -M:lint`; this does not meet the selected Amu/Kotoba ownership direction with JavaScript restricted to host APIs. Second, this exact head has no CI result. I did not run any Clojure or CLJS command. Keep the PR draft until the implementation/build path is migrated and exact-head checks pass.

+(ns kotobase.storage.kura.async
+  "Promise-based kotobase blocks packed into CARv2 objects on a Kura shard
+  fleet.
+
+  A CARv2 pack is one Kura object containing several verified CID blocks. A
+  durable CAS catalog maps each CID to the pack CID and frame range. The
+  catalog is the restart-safe lookup path; Kura's deterministic placement
+  keeps the shard list out of per-block metadata. Reads fetch just the frame's
+  data-shard ranges and verify the block CID. If a range is absent or
+  unreachable, the complete Kura object is reconstructed and its pack digest
+  is checked before the frame is returned.
+
+  `:catalog` must implement both kotobase IBlockStore and IRefStore and declare
+  `:linearizable-ref`. The ref stores immutable, content-addressed manifest
+  blocks; its CAS publishes the CID -> manifest binding once. This keeps
+  Kura's shard plane free of a process-local index and prevents two writers
+  from silently selecting different packs for one CID.
+
+  `:verify-block` is injected because a Yataverse CID may use a codec this CAR
+  helper does not hash itself (for example dag-pb). It must throw or return
+  false for a mismatch. CAR framing carries the CID bytes without changing
+  them."
+  (:require [erasure.lrc :as lrc]
+            [ipld.car :as car]
+            [ipld.car.bytes :as car-bytes]
+            [ipld.car.v2 :as car-v2]
+            [kotobase.storage.core :as storage]
+            [kura.manifest :as manifest]
+            [kura.node.async :as shard-async]
+            [kura.node.gf :as gf]
+            [kura.node.object :as kura-object]
+            [kura.node.store :as node-store]
+            [multiformats.core :as mf]))
+
+(def default-max-pack-bytes (* 4 1024 1024))
+(def default-stripe-bytes (* 4 1024 1024))
+(def default-max-catalog-cas-inflight 8)
+(def catalog-prefix "kura/carv2/v1/")
+
+(defn- promise [value]
+  (js/Promise.resolve value))
+
+(defn- all [values]
+  (js/Promise.all (clj->js (vec values))))
+
+(defn- catalog-key [cid]
+  (str catalog-prefix cid))
+
+(defn- raw-cid [bytes]
+  (mf/cidv1-raw bytes))
+
+(defn- json-bytes [value]
+  (.encode (js/TextEncoder.) (js/JSON.stringify (clj->js value))))
+
+(defn- parse-json [bytes]
+  (js->clj (.parse js/JSON (.decode (js/TextDecoder.) bytes))
+           :keywordize-keys true))
+
+(defn- verify-block! [verify-block cid bytes]
+  (when (false? (verify-block cid bytes))
+    (throw (ex-info "block verifier rejected CID bytes"
+                    {:type :kotobase.storage.kura/invalid-block
+                     :cid cid})))
+  bytes)
+
+(defn- estimate-block-bytes
+  "A safe grouping estimate: payload + CID frame + index record + per-pack
+  framing allowance. The exact archive is checked after packing as well."
+  [{:keys [cid bytes]}]
+  (let [cid-bytes (car/cid->bytes cid)
+        {:keys [digest]} (car/read-cid cid-bytes 0)]
+    (+ (car-bytes/bcount bytes)
+       (car-bytes/bcount cid-bytes)
+       (car-bytes/bcount digest)
+       64)))
+
+(defn- estimated-groups [blocks max-pack-bytes]
+  (loop [remaining (seq blocks) current [] used 64 out []]
+    (if-let [block (first remaining)]
+      (let [cost (estimate-block-bytes block)]
+        (when (> (+ cost 64) max-pack-bytes)
+          (throw (ex-info "one CID block exceeds the configured CARv2 pack limit"
+                          {:type :kotobase.storage.kura/block-too-large
+                           :cid (:cid block)
+                           :bytes (car-bytes/bcount (:bytes block))
+                           :max-pack-bytes max-pack-bytes})))
+        (if (and (seq current) (> (+ used cost) max-pack-bytes))
+          (recur remaining [] 64 (conj out current))
+          (recur (next remaining) (conj current block) (+ used cost) out)))
+      (cond-> out (seq current) (conj current)))))
+
+(defn- bounded-packs
+  "Pack deterministically and split any group whose real CAR index/framing
+  exceeds the hard size ceiling."
+  [blocks max-pack-bytes]
+  (letfn [(fit [group]
+            (let [packed (car-v2/pack {:roots [] :blocks group})
+                  size (car-bytes/bcount (:bytes packed))]
+              (if (<= size max-pack-bytes)
+                [{:blocks group :packed packed}]
+                (if (= 1 (count group))
+                  (throw (ex-info "one CARv2 frame exceeds the configured pack limit"
+                                  {:type :kotobase.storage.kura/block-too-large
+                                   :cid (:cid (first group))
+                                   :archive-bytes size
+                                   :max-pack-bytes max-pack-bytes}))
+                  (let [middle (quot (count group) 2)]
+                    (into (fit (subvec group 0 middle))
+                          (fit (subvec group middle))))))))]
+    (vec (mapcat fit (estimated-groups blocks max-pack-bytes)))))
+
+(defn- placement-for [ctx object-id]
+  (let [{:keys [plan-placement placement-context fleet layout]} ctx
+        result (plan-placement object-id layout placement-context)
+        placements (mapv #(get (:shards result) %) (range (:n layout)))]
+    (when-not (:complete? result)
+      (throw (ex-info "Kura placement cannot satisfy the configured failure-domain caps"
+                      {:type :kotobase.storage.kura/placement-shortfall
+                       :object-id object-id
+                       :shortfall (:shortfall result)})))
+    (when-not (and (= (:n layout) (count placements))
+                   (= (:n layout) (count (distinct placements)))
+                   (every? #(and (string? %) (contains? fleet %)) placements))
+      (throw (ex-info "Kura placement plan must map every shard to a distinct fleet node"
+                      {:type :kotobase.storage.kura/invalid-placement
+                       :object-id object-id
+                       :placements placements
+                       :expected-shards (:n layout)})))
+    placements))
+
+(defn- stores-for [ctx placement-ids]
+  (fn [_stripe shard-index]
+    (or (get (:fleet ctx) (nth placement-ids shard-index nil))
+        (throw (ex-info "Kura placement refers to a node absent from this fleet"
+                        {:type :kotobase.storage.kura/missing-node
+                         :node-id (nth placement-ids shard-index nil)})))))
+
+(defn- geometry [ctx object-id archive-size placement-ids]
+  (let [k (:k (:layout ctx))
+        rounded-size (* k (max 1 (quot (+ archive-size k -1) k)))
+        stripe-bytes (min (:max-stripe-bytes ctx) rounded-size)
+        plan (manifest/plan {:object-id object-id
+                             :size archive-size
+                             :stripe-bytes stripe-bytes}
+                            (:layout ctx))]
+    {:plan plan
+     :layout-config (:layout-config ctx)
+     :stripe-bytes stripe-bytes
+     :placements placement-ids}))
+
+(defn- manifest-block [metadata]
+  (let [bytes (json-bytes metadata)]
+    {:cid (raw-cid bytes) :bytes bytes}))
+
+(defn- decode-manifest-block [manifest-cid found]
+  (let [bytes (get found manifest-cid)]
+    (when (nil? bytes)
+      (throw (ex-info "catalog ref points to a missing manifest block"
+                      {:type :kotobase.storage.kura/missing-manifest
+                       :cid manifest-cid})))
+    (when-not (= manifest-cid (raw-cid bytes))
+      (throw (ex-info "catalog returned bytes under a different CID"
+                      {:type :kotobase.storage.kura/catalog-cid-mismatch
+                       :cid manifest-cid})))
+    (let [metadata (parse-json bytes)]
+      (when-not (and (= 1 (:version metadata))
+                     (string? (:pack-cid metadata))
+                     (string? (:pack-object-id metadata))
+                     (string? (:pack-digest metadata))
+                     (integer? (:archive-size metadata))
+                     (pos? (:archive-size metadata))
+                     (integer? (:stripe-bytes metadata))
+                     (pos? (:stripe-bytes metadata))
+                     (map? (:layout metadata))
+                     (vector? (:placements metadata))
+                     (vector? (:entries metadata)))
+        (throw (ex-info "Kura pack manifest has an unsupported shape"
+                        {:type :kotobase.storage.kura/invalid-manifest
+                         :cid manifest-cid})))
+      metadata)))
+
+(defn- read-manifests> [backend cids]
+  (let [catalog (:catalog backend)
+        cids (vec (distinct cids))]
+    (-> (all (map (fn [cid]
+                    (promise (storage/-read-ref catalog (catalog-key cid))))
+                  cids))
+        (.then (fn [heads]
+                 (let [refs (vec (keep (fn [[cid head]]
+                                         (when head [cid (:cid head)]))
+                                       (map vector cids (array-seq heads))))
+                       manifest-cids (vec (distinct (map second refs)))]
+                   (if (empty? manifest-cids)
+                     {}
+                     (-> (all (map (fn [manifest-cid]
+                                     (promise (storage/-get-blocks catalog [manifest-cid])))
+                                   manifest-cids))
+                         (.then (fn [blocks]
+                                  (let [decoded (into {}
+                                                      (map (fn [manifest-cid found]
+                                                             [manifest-cid
+                                                              (decode-manifest-block manifest-cid found)])
+                                                           manifest-cids
+                                                           (array-seq blocks)))]
+                                    (into {}
+                                          (map (fn [[cid manifest-cid]]
+                                                 (let [metadata (get decoded manifest-cid)
+                                                       entry (some #(when (= cid (:cid %)) %)
+                                                                   (:entries metadata))]
+                                                   (when-not entry
+                                                     (throw (ex-info "catalog CID is absent from its pack manifest"
+                                                                     {:type :kotobase.storage.kura/manifest-entry-missing
+                                                                      :cid cid
+                                                                      :manifest-cid manifest-cid})))
+                                                   [cid (merge (dissoc metadata :entries) entry)])))
+                                          refs))))))))))))
+
+(defn- read-manifest> [backend cid]
+  (-> (read-manifests> backend [cid])
+      (.then #(get % cid))))
+
+(defn- publish-manifest> [backend cid manifest-cid]
+  (let [catalog (:catalog backend)]
+    (-> (promise (storage/-compare-and-set-ref!
+                  catalog (catalog-key cid) nil manifest-cid))
+        (.then (fn [result]
+                 (boolean (:published? result)))))))
+
+(defn- pack-plan [ctx pack-object-id archive-size placement-ids]
+  (geometry ctx pack-object-id archive-size placement-ids))
+
+(defn- delete-pack!> [ctx plan placement-ids]
+  (kura-object/delete-object!>
+   {:plan plan
+    :store-for (stores-for ctx placement-ids)}))
+
+(defn- publish-pack-manifests> [backend blocks manifest-cid]
+  (reduce (fn [state-promise batch]
+            (-> state-promise
+                (.then (fn [state]
+                         (-> (all (map (fn [{:keys [cid]}]
+                                         (publish-manifest> backend cid manifest-cid))
+                                       batch))
+                             (.then (fn [outcomes]
+                                      (let [published (count (filter true?
+                                                                     (array-seq outcomes)))]
+                                        (-> state
+                                            (update :published + published)
+                                            (update :contended + (- (count batch)
+                                                                    published)))))))))))
+          (js/Promise.resolve {:published 0 :contended 0})
+          (partition-all default-max-catalog-cas-inflight blocks)))
+
+(defn- persist-pack-manifest> [backend ctx plan placement-ids blocks catalog-block receipt]
+  (-> (promise (storage/-put-blocks! (:catalog backend) [catalog-block]))
+      (.catch (fn [error]
+                (-> (delete-pack!> ctx plan placement-ids)
review-comments.body: This failure path deletes `object-id` after a catalog manifest write rejects. Because `object-id` is derived from the content-addressed pack CID, a concurrent identical writer can already have published a CID ref to the same object. Deleting it here then leaves that successful ref pointing at missing shards. Please avoid deleting the shared pack on an ambiguous catalog failure, or prove no published refs still point to it before cleanup.

review-comments.body: This still deletes the shared content-addressed object when this writer loses every CAS. If an identical concurrent writer already published these refs, both writers target `carv2-<pack-cid>` and this cleanup removes the winner's shards. A confirmed CAS loss does not prove this object's shards are unreferenced. Keep it for catalog-aware GC unless a safe coordination/ownership proof is added.
